Some bizarre revisionist history here with Love (not from Nate obviously). Love threw for 323 yards and four touchdowns in that game while taking one sack for one yard.

In the fourth quarter, Love led a touchdown drive (his kicker missed the XP), a second drive to get in range for a FG (also missed), then a two-minute drill to get in position for a shot or two to the end zone, where a pass went off his receiver's hands inside the five. (And where a field goal would have been fine if his kicker hadn't missed the extra point earlier in the quarter.) 

Lot of people to blame for the Packers losing games late. Love isn't high on that list (and certainly wasn't in the playoff loss).
